feature: Single speech indicator for /ptt, /stt and /rt as editor chips
requirements: One status for all voice modes; no multi-line local-VAD widget and no repeated transcript
Speech state chip (configurable placement, user layout topLeft): grey dot when disabled, blue armed/listening, red on air, amber transcribing, green sent, grey muted, red error
Meter chip (user layout bottomLeft): level bars, dBFS and transcription mark only while capturing
Without a chip consumer the same state renders as one ellipsized belowEditor line, removed when disabled
Space types during PTT and /rt mic; Ctrl-Space or Enter sends; Esc keeps the draft; Ctrl-C cancels
/ptt arms PTT until /ptt stop; bare Ctrl-Space is one-shot
editorChips.hiddenStatuses hides quiet third-party statuses such as jev and surfaces failures once
